title: ErrorCodeRegistry
description: Error-code registry (planning/06 §2): the stable machine `code` of every RFC 9457 problem the API answers, with its HTTP status, `title` and meaning, in registry order. Codes are stable wire values: add, never rename or reuse. The code pattern and the status range equal `ProblemDetails.code` and `ProblemDetails.status` of packages/contracts/openapi/modules/platform.yaml, which stays a pattern, not an enum, so a new code changes no contract. packages/contracts/tests/kernel-enums.test.ts fails when an OpenAPI file names a code missing here.

codes.description: Code (the wire value of `ProblemDetails.code`) to its definition

title.description: RFC 9457 `title`: the same short summary for every occurrence of the code

description.description: What the code means and when the API answers it, with the document that decides it
